tests.name: gateway alive (this change does not touch the gateway)

tests.reason: The change is the PostgREST-Aurora proxy's nginx routing. The proxy has no public endpoint yet (the next step of VTID-05023), so a staging HTTP probe cannot reach it. This builds the real image and proves every route against a mock Supabase: auth, storage, functions, realtime websocket upgrade, a 30 MB upload, the 50 MB functions cap, /rest to PostgREST, and 501 for unknown paths. It fails on the previous config.
